resources.string: Share your connection. Keep the speed.
Start FreeShare, connect another device, then follow the setup guide below.
Start sharing to see connected devices
Choose its operating system. You only need to do this once per network.

1. Open Wi‑Fi and join %1$s using the password above.

2. Open System Settings › Network › Wi‑Fi › Details › Proxies.

3. Turn on both Web Proxy and Secure Web Proxy. For each one, enter %2$s as the server and %3$d as the port.

4. Select OK. When finished, turn both proxy switches off before returning to another Wi‑Fi network.

1. Open Wi‑Fi and join %1$s using the password above.

2. Open Settings › Network & internet › Proxy.

3. Under Manual proxy setup, turn on Use a proxy server. Enter %2$s for the address and %3$d for the port.

4. Select Save. Turn the proxy switch off when you leave the FreeShare network.

1. Open Settings › Wi‑Fi and join %1$s using the password above.

2. Tap the information button beside the connected network.

3. Tap Configure Proxy › Manual. Enter %2$s as the server and %3$d as the port.

4. Tap Save. Set Configure Proxy back to Off when you leave this network.

1. Open Wi‑Fi and join %1$s using the password above.

2. Open that network’s details, tap Edit, then open Advanced options.

3. Set Proxy to Manual. Enter %2$s as the proxy host and %3$d as the port.

4. Save. Change Proxy back to None when you leave this network.

1. Open Wi‑Fi and join %1$s using the password above.

2. Open Settings › Network › Network Proxy and choose Manual.

3. Enter %2$s and port %3$d for both HTTP and HTTPS.

4. Apply the change. Return Network Proxy to Off when you leave FreeShare.
FreeShare only accepts connections from its private Wi‑Fi network. Secure websites stay encrypted from your device to the website.
Nearby-device permission is required to create the Wi‑Fi Direct group.
Turn on Wi‑Fi in the system panel, then tap Start sharing again.
Use DIRECT- followed by two letters or digits, then an optional custom name (32 bytes maximum).
